deduplication.existing_authority: go_kernel.Authority + Authorization already bind subject, tool scope, task context, expiry and provenance
deduplication.existing_governance: ToolGovernance already owns schema validation, authorization, approval, execution gate, ledger, witness and replay
deduplication.existing_objective_router: objective_router already owns discovery, bounded selection, failure taxonomy, retry and replan
deduplication.existing_execution: DurableExecution remains the sole durable execution owner
deduplication.existing_vps: VPS2ExecutionBridge and prior live evidence reused; no second VPS executor

true_gap.finding: HG_SESSION authorization could reach any registered tool once provenance was valid; server-side capability delegation was not an explicit allowlist
true_gap.secondary_finding: objective filtering could semantically downgrade an unavailable mutation objective into an available read capability

implementation.design: Existing Authority remains the grant primitive; HG_READONLY_V1 is a server-owned capability profile. No CapabilityGrant engine or second governance plane was created.

runtime_boundary.reason: Patch is intentionally isolated on a verification branch; deployment/merge is outside this mandate's authority boundary.
